Astrology & AI Disclaimer

Effective 5 October 2026 · Version 2026-10-05

If you are thinking about harming yourself, or you or someone else is in danger, call Tele-MANAS on 14416 (free, 24×7, in many Indian languages) or the emergency number 112 now. Astrobro.ai cannot help in an emergency.

1. Astrology is a belief system

Vedic astrology is a traditional system of interpretation. It is not a proven science, and no one can predict the future with certainty. Everything Astrobro.ai shows (charts, horoscopes, dasha periods, doshas, matching scores, muhurat dates, remedies and readings) is guidance for personal reflection and entertainment. We do not promise that any prediction will come true or that any remedy will work.

2. AI answers are made by a machine

  • Answers in AI Jyotish, AI-written report text and AI summaries are produced by an artificial intelligence (AI) model, not by a human astrologer. They are marked as AI answers in the app.
  • Our own engine calculates the chart facts and passes them to the AI, but the AI can still misunderstand them, mix up terms, or state things that are wrong with confidence.
  • No human checks AI answers before you see them. Do not treat them as the opinion of an expert.

3. Not professional advice

Nothing on Astrobro.ai replaces a qualified professional. In particular:

  • Health: Astrobro.ai does not diagnose or treat any illness. Never stop, delay or change medical treatment or medicines because of a reading or a remedy. See a doctor.
  • Mental health: readings are not counselling or therapy. If you feel low, anxious or hopeless, please talk to a doctor or call Tele-MANAS on 14416.
  • Money and investments: Astrobro.ai does not give investment, trading, stock, cryptocurrency or betting advice. Only advisers registered with SEBI may give investment advice.
  • Law: Astrobro.ai does not give legal advice. See a lawyer.
  • Marriage, career and family decisions: you can use astrology as one input, but make important decisions yourself, with the people involved and with proper professional advice.

4. Remedies, mantras, gemstones and rituals

  • Remedies shown in the app (mantras, fasting, charity, rituals, gemstones and others) are traditional suggestions. They are optional and depend on your own faith.
  • No remedy cures a disease or medical condition. We do not make, and do not allow astrologers to make, claims that a remedy can cure or prevent illness.
  • Never spend money you cannot afford, and never do anything that could harm you, another person or an animal. Astrobro.ai does not sell gemstones. Buy them, if you choose to, at your own discretion.
  • Practices such as "black magic", vashikaran and exorcism for money are not offered on Astrobro.ai and may be illegal.

5. Astrologers' views are their own

Astrologers on Astrobro.ai are independent practitioners. Their opinions are their own and are not checked by us before you hear them. They are not allowed to promise results, give medical, legal or financial advice, or pressure you into buying anything. If one does, please report it.

6. Accuracy depends on your details

Calculations depend on the date, time and place of birth you enter. A birth time that is out by a few minutes can change the ascendant, houses and dasha dates. Results follow common Vedic methods (Lahiri ayanamsa); other methods and traditions can give different results.

7. Dates and timings

Festival dates, muhurat and Panchang timings are calculated. Local customs and calendars can differ. For important ceremonies, please confirm the timing with your family priest or a local pandit.

8. Games

Tarot, the love calculator, FLAMES and similar features are games for entertainment only.

9. Your decisions

You are responsible for the decisions you make. To the extent the law allows, Astrobro.ai is not responsible for any loss that results from relying on a reading, an AI answer or an astrologer's advice. See the Terms of Use.
